mapper.select: SELECT * FROM inventory_reservations WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_reservations SET status='COMMITTED',committed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, released_at=CASE WHEN #{fromStatus}='RELEASED' THEN NULL ELSE released_at END, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status=#{fromStatus}
UPDATE inventory_reservations SET status='RELEASED',released_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='RESERVED'
UPDATE inventory_reservations SET status='REFUNDED',version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='COMMITTED'
mapper.select: SELECT customer_id FROM shop_orders WHERE id=#{orderId}
